rows.grounds: optative of root dhṛ, third person singular active
compound siddha+vajra in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What should be held in all circumstances for achieving fame?
items.inference: The practitioner should hold the siddha-vajra in all contexts to attain fame.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of siddha-vajra is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: One should hold the siddha-vajra in all things for fame.
